entities.summary: Andriy Vasylyovych Taran is a Ukrainian politician who last served as Ukraine's ambassador to Slovenia from 2022 to 2024. He was the 16th Minister of Defence of Ukraine and before that a lieutenant general in the Ukrainian Armed Forces.
